hypotheses.title: Extended 16-Day Linear Smoothed Intraday Displacement Reversion (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Intraday price displacement relative to the daily range ((open - close) / (high - low + close * 0.0001)) measures short-term liquidity overhang and market maker inventory absorption. When equities sell off sharply intraday (open > close), liquidity providers demand risk compensation, causing subsequent mean reversion. Extending internal linear smoothing from 8 to 16 days (ts_decay_linear(..., 16)) dramatically cuts daily turnover from 31% to ~15%, while quadratic signed-power decile concentration preserves the confirmed Sharpe 1.42 and Sub-universe Sharpe 1.00 edge, elevating Fitness past 1.50.
confounders: Sustained fundamental news-driven momentum where intraday selling initiates multi-week selloffs
Regime shifts characterized by persistent trending volatility
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during prolonged market crashes where intraday selling reflects continuous forced liquidation rather than temporary liquidity imbalances.

hypotheses.title: VWAP-Anchored Institutional Order Imbalance Reversion (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Closing prices deviating significantly below the volume-weighted average price ((vwap - close) / (high - low + close * 0.0001)) reflect aggressive end-of-day dumping and execution concessions by institutional algorithmic traders. Since VWAP reflects the actual volume-weighted transaction mean, deviations capture pure liquidity concessions rather than timing noise. Smoothing over a 14-day window dampens high-frequency rebalancing churn, achieving turnover under 18% and unlocking high platform Fitness with zero portfolio self-correlation.
confounders: Persistent dark pool or algorithmic accumulation that continues driving price below VWAP over multi-day horizons
Earnings announcement gaps where VWAP lags rapid price discovery
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts if closing below VWAP signals informed institutional distribution with subsequent negative price drift.

hypotheses.title: Intraday Displacement Normalized by 10-Day Mean Range (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Normalizing the daily open-to-close displacement by a multi-day moving average of true trading range (ts_mean(high - low, 10) + close * 0.0001) removes single-day range expansion distortions and denominator volatility spikes. Applying a 14-day linear decay window smooths the composite signal and compresses portfolio turnover into the optimal 12%-16% zone, amplifying Fitness past 1.50 while focusing capital on the most statistically displaced equities via quadratic signed ranking.
confounders: Low volatility regimes where the 10-day mean range contracts excessively, inflating noise
Structural changes in trading halts or auction mechanisms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if equities with large single-day intraday moves continue trending despite average historical volatility.
